# CITYCENTRE Houston

> > CITYCENTRE is a mixed-use shopping, dining, and entertainment destination in Houston featuring retail stores, restaurants, live events, and community gatherings.

CITYCENTRE Houston offers a curated experience with popular dining spots like Café Moran, retail destinations including Warby Parker, and regular entertainment programming such as Live in the Plaza concerts. The center provides comprehensive visitor amenities including parking and contact information for guests.

- [Contact, Parking, and FAQs](https://www.citycentrehouston.com/visit): Visitor info, parking options, FAQs, and contact details for CITYCENTRE

## Events & Entertainment

- [Mar 20 Live in the Plaza](https://www.citycentrehouston.com/event/mar-20-live-in-the-plaza): Live pop-rock concert featuring Justin Pena at City Centre Plaza

## Dining & Retail Promotions

- [Café Moran Weekly Specials](https://www.citycentrehouston.com/promos/cafe-moran-weekly-specials): Weekly breakfast specials at Café Moran including tacos and French toast
- [Specials at Warby Parker](https://www.citycentrehouston.com/promos/specials-at-warby-parker): Warby Parker eyeglasses and contact lens discounts at CITYCENTRE
